description: This file defines the DatabaseStorage class, a Drupal core component implementing a key/value store using a database backend. It includes methods for CRUD operations, schema management, and exception handling specific to database interactions.

classes.name: DatabaseStorage
classes.description: Implements a key/value store using a database table, with methods for data access, modification, and schema management, tailored for Drupal core.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the DatabaseStorage with collection name, serializer, database connection, and optional table name.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Checks if a key exists in the store.

methods.name: getMultiple
methods.description: Retrieves multiple values for given keys.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all key-value pairs in the collection.

methods.name: doSet
methods.description: Saves a value for a specific key in the database.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a value for a key, with exception handling and table creation fallback.

methods.name: doSetIfNotExists
methods.description: Inserts a key-value pair only if it does not already exist.

methods.name: setIfNotExists
methods.description: Attempts to set a key-value pair if it does not exist, with fallback.

methods.name: rename
methods.description: Renames a key in the store.

methods.name: deleteAll
methods.description: Deletes all key-value pairs in the collection.

methods.name: ensureTableExists
methods.description: Checks for the existence of the table and creates it if missing.

methods.name: catchException
methods.description: Handles exceptions, rethrowing if the table exists and the exception is not a DatabaseException.

methods.name: schemaDefinition
methods.description: Defines the schema for the key_value table.
